segments.name: Sterilization and Disinfection Control
products: Sterility assurance testing and laboratory services
segments.description: Manufactures biological, chemical and cleaning indicators and provides sterility assurance testing for pharmaceutical, medical device and healthcare customers.
segments.evidence: Our Sterilization and Disinfection Control division manufactures and sells biological, chemical and cleaning indicators used to assess the effectiveness of sterilization, decontamination, disinfection and cleaning processes in the pharmaceutical, medical device and healthcare industries.

segments.name: Biopharmaceutical Development
segments.description: Develops, manufactures, sells and services automated immunoassay and peptide synthesis systems for biopharmaceutical companies, CROs and academic laboratories.
segments.evidence: Our Biopharmaceutical Development division develops, manufactures, sells and services automated systems for protein analysis (immunoassays) and peptide synthesis solutions.

segments.name: Calibration Solutions
segments.description: Calibration solutions division; the supplied text does not describe its products in detail.
segments.evidence: We report our financial performance in four segments, or divisions: (1) Sterilization and Disinfection Control, (2) Biopharmaceutical Development, (3) Calibration Solutions, and (4) Clinical Genomics.

segments.name: Clinical Genomics
segments.description: Develops and sells high-throughput genetic analysis instruments, consumables and services for clinical research labs and contract research organizations.
segments.evidence: Our Clinical Genomics division develops, manufactures and sells highly sensitive high-throughput genetic analysis instruments, consumables and related services that enable clinical research labs and contract research organizations to perform genomic testing across a broad range of non-diagnostic applications in several therapeutic areas, including hereditary disease screenings, pharmacogenetics, oncology related applications and toxicology research.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay Mesa for sales of products, primarily consumables and hardware, and for discrete and ongoing maintenance, calibration and testing services.
revenueModel.evidence: Product sales consist primarily of consumables and hardware, while services consist primarily of discrete and ongoing maintenance, calibration and testing services.

changes.text: In fiscal year 2024, Mesa acquired GKE, whose results are included in the Sterilization and Disinfection Control division.
changes.evidence: Includes GKE results beginning upon acquisition in fiscal year 2024.
